# Quant.Infra.Net.Pro

> The only Charles Schwab API client that survives the 7-day refresh token expiry.
> Local trading software license for self-directed Schwab API users.
> Deploy once, call from any language, and keep the OAuth token lifecycle automated.
> Runs locally - trading data never leaves your machine.

## Product

- Name: Quant.Infra.Net.Pro
- Type: Local trading software (Blazor Server Web API + dashboard)
- .NET: 8.0 (Windows, macOS, Linux)
- License: Commercial (free 3-month trial)
- GitHub: https://github.com/memoryfraction/Quant.Infra.Net.Pro-Public
- Releases: https://github.com/memoryfraction/Quant.Infra.Net.Pro-Public/releases
- Version history / release notes: https://www.alpha-wealth-lab.com/changelog
- Latest version: 1.8.4
- Web API: Schwab Accounts, Positions, Quotes, Option Chain, Order History
- Core differentiator: automated refresh-token lifecycle (7-day expiry handled)
